headline: Atletico Madrid lose 1-2 to Barcelona as Fermin Lopez scores twice and Alvarez misses chances
facts: Giuliano Simeone put Atletico ahead in the 10th minute after a Julian Alvarez cross; Fermin Lopez equalised at 45' and scored the winner at 66'.
Alvarez missed several chances, including a one-on-one against Joan Garcia and an early lob over the keeper that frustrated some home fans.
The home crowd showed a tifo that referred to Alvarez's reluctant stay at the club after his summer transfer attempt.
The loss ended Atletico's seven-game league winning run and left them third, five points behind Barcelona.
background: Diego Simeone has coached Atletico since 2011, and last season Atletico knocked Barcelona out of both the Copa del Rey and the Champions League.

headline: Alvarez says sorry to Atletico fans after the failed Barcelona move that Atletico blocked with a EUR 100m refusal
facts: In June Alvarez told ESPN he wanted to leave Atletico, and sources said he preferred Barcelona.
Atletico refused to sell to a title rival and turned down a EUR 100m offer, so he stayed.
Fans jeered him earlier in the season over the attempt to force a move, and he has since apologised.
He had started Atletico's last four matches and scored twice; Simeone said he was in good form ahead of the Barcelona game.
background: Alvarez joined Atletico from Manchester City in 2024 and won the World Cup with Argentina in 2022.

headline: Atletico forward Ademola Lookman suffers knee ligament sprain on Nigeria duty
facts: Lookman was replaced late in the first half of Nigeria's 3-1 win over Tanzania in Uyo, and a scan showed a knee ligament sprain, per Nigeria's team statement.
He is out of the return AFCON qualifier in Zanzibar; no recovery timeline was given for Atletico.
Atletico's next games are Getafe on 22 November, Viking in the Champions League, Elche on 28 November and Barcelona on 2 December.
He scored in Atletico's 2-0 Champions League win over Manchester United on 13 October.
background: Lookman joined Atletico from Atalanta in 2025 and was named African Footballer of the Year in 2024.

headline: Zubimendi denies he wants to leave Arsenal amid Atletico interest, admits he is short of minutes
facts: Zubimendi told Marca that talk of a January exit is far from reality and that he has not contacted anyone about a move.
He has played only about 100 minutes in seven league games this season, after playing all 38 league games last season.
He said he has considered psychological help but has not taken that step, and that he is happy in London.
Arteta told him before the season that competition for minutes would rise after the arrival of Bruno Guimaraes; he is under contract until 2030.
background: Arsenal signed Zubimendi from Real Sociedad in 2025 for a reported 51 million pounds, and he was part of Spain's 2026 World Cup winning squad.

headline: Atletico beat 10-man Manchester United 2-0 as Barrios scores after 47 seconds
facts: Pablo Barrios scored after 47 seconds at the Metropolitano, and Lookman added a second at 79' from a rebound.
Leny Yoro was sent off at 74' for denying Jonathan David a clear scoring chance.
The win gave Atletico their first points of this Champions League league phase.
Captain Koke's mother died that morning, a minute's silence was held, and the win was dedicated to him.
background: Atletico lost their league-phase opener 1-2 to Liverpool, who scored a late winner through Mac Allister.
footage_terms: Yoro red card Atletico Manchester United

headline: Baena's 89th-minute goal at Espanyol gives Atletico a fifth straight league win
facts: Alex Baena scored in the 89th minute into the top corner after a pass from Julian Alvarez, which was Alvarez's first league assist of the season.
It was Atletico's fifth straight league win and their second successive late away win.
Baena came on at 62' for Lee Kang-in; Simeone praised his decisiveness and strength after last season's injuries.
Cristian Romero asked to come off with an adductor strain and missed the next Champions League trip.
background: Baena joined Atletico from Villarreal in 2025, and this was Atletico's longest league winning run since October to November 2025.

headline: Cristian Romero scores first Atletico goal, an 87th-minute header that wins at Alaves
facts: Alejandro Grimaldo opened the scoring, Lucas Boye equalised from a penalty before half-time, and Romero headed in Baena's cross in the 87th minute.
It was Romero's first goal for Atletico, and he played in a striker-like position for the finish.
The win ended a four-match winless run for Atletico.
It was Atletico's first win in four visits to Mendizorrotza.
background: Atletico signed Romero from Tottenham, where he was captain, in a reported 34 million pound deal this summer, ending a long pursuit.

headline: Bayern beat Atletico 2-0 at the Metropolitano as 18-year-old Lennart Karl breaks a record
facts: Lennart Karl scored at 54' and Konrad Laimer added a second at 74' after a pass from Harry Kane.
Karl became the fourth player to reach five Champions League goals before turning 19, after Lamine Yamal, Kylian Mbappe and Raul.
Bayern were led by assistant Aaron Danks because Vincent Kompany was absent on medical grounds.
Atletico were left with 4 points from four games and 23rd of 36 in the league phase table.
background: Atletico have reached the Champions League knockout rounds in most recent seasons under Simeone but have never won the trophy; they lost two finals to Real Madrid, in 2014 and 2016.
footage_terms: Champions League Atletico Bayern Kane assist

headline: Atletico Madrid buy 50 percent of Ecuador's Atletico FC Guayaquil, their third overseas affiliate
facts: Atletico announced on 13 November that it bought a 50 percent stake in Atletico Futbol Club, the Ecuadorian Serie B champions; no fee was disclosed.
The Guayaquil club won promotion on 15 October and clinched the title on 22 October, and will play in Serie A in 2027.
Its network already includes Atletico de San Luis in Mexico and Atletico Ottawa in Canada.
Coach Carlos Santamarina comes from Atletico's academy, which says it now works with over 14,000 young players in Guayaquil.
background: Atletico's chief executive Miguel Angel Gil Marin visited the Guayaquil academy in June 2026, and the two sides signed a strategic agreement in July 2023.
footage_terms: Atletico FC Guayaquil Serie B champions
Atletico de San Luis Atletico Ottawa network

headline: Atletico mock Real Madrid on social media over Valverde's quick return from a 'grade three' ankle sprain
facts: Valverde was hurt in the 20 September derby at the Metropolitano, which Real Madrid lost 2-1, after a challenge by Kang-in Lee.
Real Madrid announced a grade-three ankle sprain on 22 September and sought a red card for the tackle.
Valverde returned to the squad for the Villarreal game 17 days later, and Atletico's official account posted an ironic message congratulating Madrid on 'making history' by proving medicine wrong.
No formal complaint from either club was reported.
background: The Madrid derby has been a feud this season, with Mourinho, now in charge at Real Madrid, criticising the referee after the derby defeat.
footage_terms: Valverde injury Atletico Real Madrid derby

headline: Juventus reportedly consider January move for Atletico striker Alexander Sorloth
facts: ESPN's transfer roundup says Juventus are considering Sorloth, 30, for the January window, and he is described as the favourite for that club.
No fee was reported, and this is a rumour, not a confirmed deal.
Sorloth had one of Atletico's last real chances as a substitute in the 1-2 defeat to Barcelona on 8 November.
The same roundup links Atletico with Arsenal's Martin Zubimendi.
background: Sorloth is a Norwegian striker who joined Atletico from Villarreal in 2025, after a 2024-25 season in which he scored heavily for Villarreal.

headline: Atletico's Baena and Pubill score as world champions Spain win 2-0 in Czechia
facts: Alex Baena scored a penalty after a handball in the area, and Marc Pubill added a late second goal, listed at 90+6'.
Czechia were reduced to ten men when Krejci was sent off.
It was Spain's 12th straight win, and their last defeat came against Colombia in March 2024.
Spain lead Nations League Group A3, with England three points behind and due to play them at the Metropolitano.
background: Spain are the reigning world champions after the 2026 World Cup, and both goalscorers play for Atletico.

headline: Real Sociedad defender Jon Martin says he is staying despite Real Madrid and Barcelona interest
facts: Martin said Real Sociedad is his home, where he has been since he was 12, and that he is focused on the Basque derby rather than his future.
He has been linked with Real Madrid, Barcelona and big Premier League clubs, but no move is imminent.
He signed a long-term deal in July that ties him to the club until 2032.
He praised coach Pellegrino Matarazzo as close to the players and trustworthy.
background: Martin helped Real Sociedad win the Copa del Rey under Matarazzo in April and made his Spain debut in June against Iraq.
footage_terms: Real Sociedad Copa del Rey final winners

headline: Athletic Club win the Basque derby 2-1 over Real Sociedad despite having only 38 percent possession
facts: Inaki Williams scored at 14', Luka Sucic equalised at 30', and Alex Berenguer scored a penalty at 45+2'.
Real Sociedad had 62 percent of the ball, but the expected goals were 2.93 for Athletic and 1.40 for Real Sociedad.
Orri Oskarsson had a late header at 88' that was blocked.
Before the match Real Sociedad had 19 points and Athletic had 15.
background: The derby came after Real Sociedad beat Athletic in the Copa del Rey semi-final earlier in 2026 on their way to the trophy.

headline: Manchester United and Tottenham reportedly eye Real Sociedad striker Orri Oskarsson
facts: ESPN's roundup reports that Manchester United and Tottenham are interested in the 22-year-old, with Everton, Brentford and Sunderland also linked.
He has 14 goals and six assists across LaLiga and the Europa League this season.
Any deal reportedly has to exceed EUR 20m, and Atalanta were linked earlier.
He scored in the 67th minute of Real Sociedad's 1-0 win over Rayo Vallecano on 8 November.
background: Oskarsson is an Iceland international who moved to Real Sociedad from FC Copenhagen in 2024.

headline: Arsenal reportedly revive interest in Athletic Club winger Nico Williams, with Atletico's Baena also on the list
facts: Per TEAMtalk, Arsenal have reignited their interest, and Williams is now reportedly open to a move.
He signed a new 10-year contract last summer that includes a EUR 100m exit clause.
Arsenal are also said to be considering Endrick, Antonio Nusa, Kevin Schade and Atletico's Alex Baena.
This is a transfer rumour from a single report.
background: Williams helped Spain win Euro 2024 and a World Cup in 2026, and Athletic famously fields mostly players from the Basque Country.

headline: Sevilla file a formal complaint after Guler escapes an elbow card in 4-1 defeat at Real Madrid
facts: Real Madrid won 4-1 on 18 October; Guler scored at 30', Mbappe scored twice including a Panenka penalty, and Yan Diomande scored the fourth.
Sevilla say Guler was not sent off for an elbow on Peque Fernandez at 0-0, and coach Luis Garcia Plaza said his team lost the chance to play 11 against 10.
Sevilla complained to LaLiga about unequal replay coverage, and the referees committee met the club, but Sevilla disagreed with its explanation.
Mourinho said nobody had shown him a clear image of the alleged elbow.
background: Sevilla survived relegation only on the penultimate matchday of last season, and Mourinho took over at Real Madrid in the summer.
footage_terms: Garcia Plaza press conference Guler elbow

headline: Seville derby on Saturday: sixth-placed Sevilla host fourth-placed Betis
facts: The derby is on Saturday 21 November at 17:30 at the Ramon Sanchez-Pizjuan.
Sevilla have 18 points from 12 games and are sixth; Betis have 26 points and are fourth.
Sevilla's recent league results include a 3-1 loss at Getafe and a 4-1 loss at Real Madrid.
Betis have won 2-0 at Elche and lost 2-1 at Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League.
background: Sevilla only secured survival in May after a late-season run, while Betis returned to the Champions League this season after 21 years.

headline: Pellegrini blames 'inexplicable decisions' after Betis lose 2-5 to Barcelona
facts: Betis lost 2-5 at La Cartuja on 17 October, and Facundo Bernal was sent off shortly after Abde Ezzalzouli made it 3-2.
Pellegrini said a Lo Celso goal was wrongly disallowed for handball and that Barcelona's third goal should have been ruled out for a high foot by Fermin Lopez.
He felt Bernal was provoked by Lamine Yamal and that both should have been punished.
He said the game was even until the red card, and the result equalled Barcelona's record league start.
background: Pellegrini is a former Manchester City and Real Madrid coach who took over Betis in 2024 and reached the Conference League final in 2025.

headline: Isco scores twice as Betis hit five against Osasuna and climb to third
facts: Betis won 5-2 at home; Isco scored a 10th-minute penalty and a second goal after Osasuna had levelled with two goals at 56'.
Ezzalzouli, Diego Llorente and Jose Antonio Morante, who came on at 90', also scored.
Ante Budimir and Raul Garcia scored for Osasuna.
The win lifted Betis to third with 19 points from eight games, one point above Real Madrid.
background: Isco is a former Real Madrid and Spain playmaker who joined Betis in 2024 after leaving Sevilla.

headline: Chelsea reportedly approach Betis teenager Jose Antonio Morante
facts: Per TEAMtalk, Chelsea have made an approach for the 19-year-old after a strong start to the season.
Manchester City and Manchester United are also reportedly tracking him.
He scored a stoppage-time goal after coming on at 90' in Betis's 5-2 win over Osasuna in October.
This is a transfer rumour from one report, with no fee given.
background: Betis lost the 2025 Conference League final to Chelsea, so a Chelsea move for one of their youngsters would carry some irony.

headline: PSG thrash Villarreal 6-0 with the fastest four goals in Champions League history
facts: PSG led 4-0 after 17 minutes, faster than Real Madrid's 20 minutes against Dinamo Zagreb in 2011.
Fabian Ruiz scored twice, and 17-year-old David Boly scored on his Champions League debut at 78'.
PSG now have 18 goals in four games, the most by any team in the first four matches of a Champions League season.
Three of the first goals came from Villarreal errors playing out from the back; Luis Enrique said the early lead decided the game.
background: Villarreal finished third in LaLiga last season to reach the Champions League, and PSG are the defending champions chasing a third straight title.
footage_terms: PSG fastest four goals Champions League

headline: Valencia loanee Harvey Elliott sent off for two yellow cards in under a minute in loss to Villarreal
facts: Elliott was shown two yellow cards less than a minute apart in the 89th minute at 1-1, apparently for dissent over a decision against a teammate.
Georges Mikautadze then scored in the sixth minute of stoppage time to give Villarreal a 2-1 win.
Elliott had made six substitute appearances for Valencia without starting, with no goals or assists.
He had joined on loan in the summer after not fitting into new Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola's plans.
background: Elliott's previous loan at Aston Villa was poor, and Unai Emery left him out of the first-team squad.
footage_terms: Harvey Elliott red card Valencia Villarreal
Elliott two yellow cards one minute

headline: Vinicius Junior sent off and has goal ruled out for pulling Villarreal's Saliba by the hair
facts: After a VAR review, Vinicius's goal was disallowed and he was shown a red card for pulling Villarreal midfielder Nathan Saliba's hair.
Real Madrid still won 1-0 against Villarreal, with Yan Diomande scoring the winner.
ESPN reported that Vinicius served the first game of a four-match ban against Sevilla on 18 October.
Real Madrid's Mourinho later said Vinicius should move on from his difficult summer.
background: Vinicius is playing under Mourinho at Real Madrid this season, and Mourinho has said he should move on from his difficult summer.
footage_terms: Vinicius red card hair pull Saliba

headline: Valencia ask Aston Villa about a January loan for Tammy Abraham while sitting 19th
facts: Per Matteo Moretto, Valencia have contacted Aston Villa about a January loan for 29-year-old Tammy Abraham, with part of his salary covered.
Abraham has started only once under Unai Emery this season.
Valencia are 19th in LaLiga with 9 points from 12 games, with two wins, three draws and seven defeats.
This is a reported enquiry, not a confirmed deal.
background: Valencia fired coach Carlos Corberan by video call from Singapore after a 1-0 loss to Sevilla in September, then hired Javier Aguirre on 28 September.

headline: Dani Carvajal close to joining Getafe after leaving Real Madrid, pending LaLiga salary-limit approval
facts: Reports said the 34-year-old defender completed a medical and agreed terms with Getafe, but the deal is not official until LaLiga approves his registration.
His Real Madrid contract expired on 30 June 2026, so no fee is due.
Getafe must free up room under LaLiga's salary limit before they can register him.
Coach Jose Bordalas reportedly phoned Carvajal himself to explain his role; this is the situation as of 7 October.
background: Carvajal made his final Real Madrid appearance in May, setting up a goal in the win over Athletic Club, after winning multiple Champions League titles with the club.

headline: Rayo's Sergio Camello has seven goals in seven games while Vallecas stadium stays closed
facts: Camello has seven goals in seven LaLiga games, and only Barcelona's Raphinha has scored more among Europe's top five leagues.
His previous league seasons brought five, three and three goals.
Madrid's council declared the Vallecas stadium unsafe, so Rayo played home games in Leganes while fans boycotted; they were due back on 10 October.
Camello credits more freedom, new coach Benat San Jose and therapy, and mentioned an anxiety episode after the Olympics.
background: Rayo reached the Conference League final last season, losing to Crystal Palace, and then lost coach Inigo Perez in the summer.
footage_terms: Rayo Vallecano Leganes home games boycott

headline: Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel dies after on-field collision with Andorra goalkeeper
facts: The 30-year-old Tenerife striker died on 3 November after a cardiac arrest the previous day, following a collision with Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono in a Segunda match.
The match was abandoned in stoppage time, and De Miguel was treated on the pitch for more than five minutes before going to hospital.
Spanish police opened a routine investigation into possible involuntary manslaughter because the death was non-natural.
LaLiga, UEFA, Barcelona and Real Madrid sent condolences; Atletico and Barcelona held a minute's applause for him before their 8 November game.
background: De Miguel wore number nine and had earlier spent two and a half years at Castellon before joining Tenerife in 2025.
footage_terms: LaLiga minute silence Jesus de Miguel

headline: LaLiga names 2025-26 award winners, with Levante's 20-year-old Carlos Espi best under-23 player
facts: Carlos Espi, 20, won best under-23 player after scoring 11 goals in his first top-flight season, 10 of them in the last 13 matchdays, which helped Levante avoid relegation.
Joan Garcia won Best Save of the Season for a stop in the derby against Espanyol, beating Jan Oblak and Unai Simon in the final vote.
Yamal won Best Player with 16 goals and 12 assists, and Hansi Flick won Best Coach after Barcelona's second straight title with 94 points.
The awards will be presented on 28 December in the UAE at the Globe Soccer Awards.
background: Levante were promoted to LaLiga for the 2025-26 season and finished the year safe thanks largely to the late goals of a Valencian striker still in his first top-flight campaign.
footage_terms: Joan Garcia best save Espanyol derby

headline: LaLiga and Tebas apologise to Chinese fans over Mbappe row as brands cut ties
facts: LaLiga said comments by Mbappe offended Chinese fans, stressed he made them personally, and apologised on behalf of the league and its clubs.
Tebas apologised personally and the league promised an awareness and communication protocol for clubs and players.
Football Espana reported that Dongpeng, Mengniu and Milkground ended deals with Mbappe, and China Media Group reportedly suspended LaLiga broadcasts; the underlying clip is unverified.
Mbappe and the show involved had not responded at the time of the report.
background: Mbappe joined Real Madrid in 2024 and has been LaLiga's biggest global star; LaLiga has a large Chinese audience.

headline: Spain's Supreme Court makes annulment of LaLiga's 2021 CVC vote final, but the deal stands
facts: The Supreme Court rejected LaLiga's cassation appeal, making the annulment of the 12 August 2021 General Assembly vote that approved the CVC deal final, and LaLiga must pay the costs.
Real Madrid and Athletic Club won the case, while the separate December 2021 approval of the LaLiga Impulso project stays in force.
Under that deal clubs received about EUR 2bn in exchange for a share of audiovisual rights income over 50 years.
Real Madrid has taken the December ruling to the Supreme Court, which has not yet decided whether to admit the appeal.
background: Real Madrid, Barcelona and Athletic Club rejected the CVC deal in 2021, and the conflict between Real Madrid and LaLiga president Javier Tebas has run for years.
